title: Oxtail stew
intro: Jamaican braised oxtail is a rich, slow-cooked stew built on the deep flavour of caramelised brown sugar and long-braised oxtail, a dish rooted in the island's tradition of making the most of tougher, well-worked cuts of meat. It's a hearty, comforting classic, usually served over rice, with butter beans added for body and a gentle Scotch bonnet aroma running through the gravy.
